accepted_answers.name: Scrapy
accepted_answers.why: The full crawling framework: spiders, item pipelines, scheduling/dedupe, throttling, exports; gold standard for high-volume crawls since 2008.

accepted_answers.name: requests + BeautifulSoup (small jobs)
accepted_answers.why: Accepted for small-scale static scraping: shortest path when crawl machinery is unnecessary.

accepted_answers.name: Playwright (JS-rendered targets)
accepted_answers.why: Accepted when content only exists after JavaScript runs: real-browser rendering, interaction, network interception.

notes: Consensus is a decision tree, not a single tool: Scrapy for crawls-as-systems, requests+BS4 for scripts, Playwright for JS-heavy targets. Selenium is legacy for new scraping work.
problem: Building production web scraping (framework choice for crawls, parsing, and JS rendering).
